## Story Goal

Enable authenticated staff (roles `Admin`, `Supervisor`, `Agent`) to update the **`Status`** of an existing ticket via a dedicated backend endpoint. When the caller submits a valid `TicketStatus` value for an existing ticket, the ticket's status is persisted and the audit fields (`UpdatedAt`, `UpdatedBy` on `BaseEntity`) are populated automatically by the existing `AuditableEntitySaveChangesInterceptor`. Invalid enum values return HTTP 400; unknown ticket ids return HTTP 404.

**In scope:** a single write endpoint, its request DTO, validator, application service (or handler), controller action, unit + integration tests.

**Out of scope:** ticket history/audit trail read model (feeds `tickets/view-ticket-history`), escalation (`tickets/escalate-ticket`), UI in the customer/agent frontends, transition rules, notifications.

## Product rules (from story)

**Current behaviour:** no endpoint exists for changing status; the field is only set at creation time.

**New behaviour:**
- Given an authenticated staff caller and an existing ticket, submitting a valid `TicketStatus` value updates the ticket and returns HTTP 200 (or 204).
- Given an invalid/unknown status value (enum parse failure or value outside declared members), respond with HTTP 400 and a validation error payload.
- Given a ticket id that does not exist (or is soft-deleted), respond with HTTP 404.
- The change **must** persist through `IUnitOfWork.SaveChangesAsync` so `AuditableEntitySaveChangesInterceptor` records `UpdatedAt`/`UpdatedBy` on the ticket row. No separate history table is written in this story.

**Create file:** `src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Application/Features/Tickets/ChangeStatus/ChangeTicketStatusHandler.cs`

```csharp
namespace CustomerSupportCRM.Application.Features.Tickets.ChangeStatus;

using CustomerSupportCRM.Domain.Entities;      // Ticket
using CustomerSupportCRM.Domain.Exceptions;    // NotFoundException
using CustomerSupportCRM.Domain.Interfaces;    // IUnitOfWork

public sealed class ChangeTicketStatusHandler : IChangeTicketStatusHandler
{
    private readonly IUnitOfWork _unitOfWork;
    private readonly ITicketHistoryWriter _historyWriter; // optional; null if history story not yet landed

    public ChangeTicketStatusHandler(IUnitOfWork unitOfWork, ITicketHistoryWriter historyWriter = null)
    {
        _unitOfWork = unitOfWork;
        _historyWriter = historyWriter;
    }

    public async Task HandleAsync(Guid ticketId, ChangeTicketStatusRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var repo = _unitOfWork.Repository<Ticket>();
        var ticket = await repo.GetByIdAsync(ticketId, cancellationToken)
                     ?? throw new NotFoundException(nameof(Ticket), ticketId);

        var oldStatus = ticket.Status;
        ticket.Status = request.Status;
        repo.Update(ticket);
        
        // Record the status change to history (if the writer is available)
        if (_historyWriter != null)
        {
            await _historyWriter.AppendAsync(
                ticketId,
                TicketHistoryEventType.StatusChanged,
                oldValue: oldStatus.ToString(),
                newValue: request.Status.ToString(),
                note: null,
                cancellationToken);
        }
        
        await _unitOfWork.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
    }
}
```

> If `Ticket` exposes `Status` only through a domain method (e.g. `ChangeStatus(TicketStatus)`) rather than a public setter, call that method instead. Confirm by grepping `class Ticket` under `src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.Domain/Entities/` before implementing.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Invalid enum value in body (e.g. `"status": 99` or `"status": "Bogus"`):** rejected by `ChangeTicketStatusRequestValidator.IsInEnum()`; `ValidationFilter` (`src/BackEnd/src/CustomerSupportCRM.API/Filters/ValidationFilter.cs`) returns HTTP 400 before the handler runs.
- **Missing/null body:** `[ApiController]` (see `BaseApiController.cs` line 10) auto-returns HTTP 400 for model-binding failures.
- **Unknown ticket id:** `GetByIdAsync` returns `null`; handler throws `NotFoundException(nameof(Ticket), ticketId)` → 404 via `GlobalExceptionHandler`.
- **Soft-deleted ticket:** the EF global filter (`ApplicationDbContext.ApplySoftDeleteQueryFilters`, lines 37–53) excludes rows with `IsDeleted = true`, so `GetByIdAsync` returns `null` and the caller sees 404 — same path as "unknown id".
- **Unauthenticated caller:** `[Authorize]` returns 401 before the action runs.
- **Authenticated caller without a permitted role (`Customer`, unknown role, or role-less user):** returns 403.
- **Concurrent updates to the same ticket:** last write wins; no explicit concurrency token is introduced in this story. Document as a known follow-up in a code comment above the handler.
- **Setting status to the current status (no-op):** still calls `Update` and `SaveChangesAsync`; the interceptor will refresh `UpdatedAt`/`UpdatedBy`. This is acceptable and testable.
- **Ticket entity uses a domain method instead of a public setter:** implementer must call that method (see note under §1). If neither is available, escalate to the `tickets/create-ticket` story owner rather than adding a new mutation surface here.
- **Cancellation:** the `CancellationToken` is threaded end-to-end and honoured by both `GetByIdAsync` and `SaveChangesAsync`.
